changes.right_edge_copy: Allow the observed non-half A8 tail only when origin is inside EFB and right edge is <=647. Keep requested 8x70 destination and source sampling extent; clip clear region. Explicit clamp-to-edge sampler fills the out-of-range tail.
changes.fidelity_limit: Valid source texel spacing is preserved. Tail values outside hardware EFB are not established as hardware-exact; deterministic edge clamp is documented. Other unsupported outside rectangles still fail.
